Thanks for agreeing to work with Acme Cloud Services on their marketplace listing. Attached is the marketplace onboarding CSV we typically ask vendors to complete, plus the PO intake form we need filled to start activation on AWS/Azure/GCP.

Thanks Vanessa / Maya. Quick checklist for marketplace activation across providers — I tried to keep this pragmatic: 

AWS Marketplace
- AWS seller registration (AMZN Seller ID) — we can reuse our corporate seller profile but need the vendor's billing contact for pass-through billing.
- Billing mapping: need vendor_to_customer mapping CSV (column: internal_sku, acme_sku, price_usd).
- PO: Acme prefers a signed PO from Redwood with billing reference; attach Signed_PO_Template.docx to get legal sign-off.

Azure Marketplace
- Azure requires the publisher offer ID and a partner tenant ID for listing.
- Invoice remit address required for MS billing reconciliation.

GCP Marketplace
- GCP primarily uses billing account number and supporting CSV for unit pricing.
- Need service account name for automated metering (if applicable).

Open questions for vendor team:
- Do you have a current Redwood W9 on file? If not, please attach.
- Any special tax-exempt status to flag?

Deliverables and owners:
- Marketplace_Onboarding_Form.csv (vendor) — complete and return to CloudBridge + Karthik.
- Vendor_W9.pdf (vendor) — attach to thread.
- Signed_PO_Template.docx (procurement) — Laura to generate final PO/number.

If we get everything by EOD Wed (Dec 2), I can kick the marketplace listing flows on Dec 3.

— Karthik
Director, Marketplace Operations
Redwood Inference

Hi all,

Attached: Vendor_W9.pdf — apologies for the delay. A couple of clarifications from Acme procurement:
1) They asked whether Redwood can accept a consolidated monthly invoice for all marketplace usage vs separate invoices per SKU. Is that possible?
2) They want the PO to reference the Redwood billing account RDW-ACCT-0042 for reconciliation.

On our side we completed Marketplace_Onboarding_Form.csv (filled) and included sample SKU mappings. I'll attach the CSV to the DocuSign envelope.

Attachments: Vendor_W9.pdf, Marketplace_Onboarding_Form_filled.csv

Thanks,
Priya N.

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Kickoff: Vendor onboarding + PO intake for Acme listing

Thanks Priya — received the W9 and the completed CSV. Good to hear about the SKU mapping. Answering your questions:
- Consolidated monthly invoice: yes, we can support consolidated billing. We'll map that to Acme's PO and issue one invoice per month with line-level SKU detail for their reconciliation team.
- Billing account: we'll reference RDW-ACCT-0042 on the PO.

Laura — please proceed with generating the external PO in our system. We will sign the PO template and route to Acme procurement for countersignature via DocuSign. Karthik — once we have the PO number, can you confirm which marketplace provider flows we should prioritize (AWS first, then Azure, GCP)? My ask: prioritize AWS activation, since Acme's procurement team indicated AWS listing is the gating factor.

Next steps (mutual action plan):
- Today: Laura issues Redwood PO and uploads to HubSpot (assign to deal RDW-2026-ACME-53).
- EOD Wed (Dec 2): Vendor countersigns DocuSign envelope.
- Thu (Dec 3): Karthik kicks off AWS listing; CloudBridge confirms pass-through mapping.

Thanks all — looping Sergio for final listing artifacts.

Vanessa Ortiz
